incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGE FIRED for reserved-capacity-throttle — tenant=maplepay-prod, cluster=dedicated-us-west-2-3
PagerDuty: Trigger: reserved-capacity-throttle for MaplePay Prod — urgency=high — runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/reserved-capacity
Sarah Harris: acked via PD :white_check_mark: picking up
Sarah Harris: getting initial metrics — p95 requests queuing, p99 token latency spiking
Mike Chen: looks like sustained queue depth on tenant queue, throttles reported by allocator
Mike Chen: logs: `allocator: throttle=1.0 tenant=maplepay-prod pool=reserved-usw2-3 reason=capacity_exhausted`
Eli Kapoor: confirmed — delta in traffic ~3x baseline for last 6m. No recent deploys from MaplePay that I see
Sarah Harris: customer-facing impact? Jenna, can you check with MAPLEPAY slack?
Jenna (Customer Ops): pinged customer, they're seeing failed generation requests and elevated latencies since ~13:04 UTC. They're flagging errors code 429 and occasional 504s
Sarah Harris: immediate mitigation plan: 1) try transient burst to reserved pool 2) activate fallback routing to hosted-model-compat for non-sensitive routes 3) enable prefix KV cache for hot prompts
Mike Chen: running command to add 2 GPUs to reserved pool: `rdctl reserved scale --tenant maplepay-prod --add-gpus 2 --pool reserved-usw2-3`
incident-bot: action submitted — run_id=run_99231
Mike Chen: rdctl returned: queued-scale-request id=qr_883, expected apply_time ~ 60s
Eli Kapoor: while scale applies, we should enable circuit-breaker fallback for low-trust routes: `routectl set-fallback --tenant maplepay-prod --policy hosted-compatible --probability 0.3`
Sarah Harris: applying fallback (0.3) now
incident-bot: route change recorded — change_id=rc_554
Mike Chen: scale applied: pool reserved-usw2-3 +2 GPUs -> new capacity metering shows freed up 18% headroom
Mike Chen: re-checking queue depths — queue depth reduced from 120 -> 18 in ~90s
Eli Kapoor: p99 token latency dropped 820ms -> 210ms, p95 back under SLO for most routes
Jenna (Customer Ops): customer confirms partial recovery for most requests, still seeing some 429s on heavy rerank endpoints
Sarah Harris: can we enable temporary request-level throttling for heavy rerank endpoints to protect core traffic?
Mike Chen: toggling rerank throttle to 0.6 to shed 40% load on that subroute: `routectl set-rate --tenant maplepay-prod --route /v1/rerank --qps 60`
incident-bot: config change accepted — cfg_id=cg_221
Mike Chen: rerank 429s dropped significantly, overall error rate down from 7.4% -> 1.2% in last 2m
Sarah Harris: taking notes for handoff — initial mitigation completed (scale + fallback + rerank throttling). Still needs follow-up: root cause investigation, sustained autoscale config review, customer postmortem invite
Sarah Harris: handing off to next on-call Eli for 2h steady-state and RCA start. @Eli Kapoor you good to take? :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Eli Kapoor: taking it. I'll keep the timeline and start digging into why autoscale didn't trigger earlier. Will loop infra team if allocator mis-sizing
Jenna (Customer Ops): emailed customer with ETA and summary of mitigations at 13:12 UTC. Will keep them updated and schedule postmortem call if needed
Sarah Harris: thanks team. After-action items: 1) verify autoscale thresholds for reserved pools (owner: eng-platform) 2) add rerank backpressure circuit into runbook (owner: eng-runtime) 3) customer follow-up and postmortem (owner: customer-success)
Eli Kapoor: creating incident ticket now and tagging eng-platform + eng-runtime + customer-success: INC-2026-0423
incident-bot: PagerDuty incident closed (ack resolved) — resolution: mitigation applied, monitoring steady for 10m
Eli Kapoor: I'll keep the channel open for updates. If we see >5% error rate again we'll re-escalate. :mag:
Sarah Harris: reassigning final follow-ups to relevant owners in ticket. Good work everyone :thumbsup:
